info.title: FlyItalyADSB API
info.summary: Live and historical aircraft positions worldwide from the FlyItalyADSB community ADS-B/MLAT network. Commercial use allowed on every plan, Free included; the whole world in one request from the Pro plan (€49/month).
info.description: Unfiltered aircraft data (no FAA/LADD/BARR filtering; military aircraft included, many of them via MLAT) from a global community-run receiver network (about 3,200 receivers, densest in North America and Europe; any point on Earth can be queried), as readsb aircraft.json records (the same format as tar1090), plus an ADS-B Exchange v2–compatible variant at /api/aircraft/v2. Every endpoint except the key signup needs an X-Api-Key; keys are self-serve (see /auth.md). Plans and limits: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/#piani. The same key works on the MCP server at https://flyitalyadsb.com/mcp. The same data is also served in the ADS-B Exchange v2 format (same paths, key headers and JSON; radius in nautical miles) at https://api.flyitalyadsb.com/api/aircraft/v2, documented at https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/adsbx-v2/.

get.summary: One aircraft by ICAO address

parameters.name: hex
parameters.description: 24-bit ICAO address, hex (case-insensitive, an 0x prefix is accepted).

200.description: The aircraft currently seen with this identifier, unchanged. X-Matched-As and X-Matched-Value are present when it was found under another form of the identifier.

404.description: No aircraft with this identifier is in the air and seen by the network right now. The body says what was tried, a hint, `found_as` when the text is another identifier of an airborne aircraft, and `last_seen`, the last observed flight, when there is one.

get.summary: One aircraft by ICAO address (alias of /v2/icao)

parameters.name: hex
parameters.description: 24-bit ICAO address, hex (case-insensitive, an 0x prefix is accepted).

200.description: The aircraft currently seen with this identifier, unchanged. X-Matched-As and X-Matched-Value are present when it was found under another form of the identifier.

404.description: No aircraft with this identifier is in the air and seen by the network right now. The body says what was tried, a hint, `found_as` when the text is another identifier of an airborne aircraft, and `last_seen`, the last observed flight, when there is one.

get.summary: One aircraft by callsign (flight numbers tried too)
get.description: Tries, in order: the callsign as written; without the zeros after the airline prefix (CPA0289 -> CPA289); the ICAO form of the airline's IATA code (FR5518 -> RYR5518, 5X1219 -> UPS1219). Some airlines (Ryanair, easyJet, Wizz Air) mostly fly alphanumeric callsigns not linked to the flight number. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#callsign-and-flight-number

parameters.name: callsign
parameters.description: Callsign as transmitted (e.g. RYR55NU, BAW185) or a flight number (e.g. FR5518, BA0185); case and spaces ignored.

200.description: The aircraft currently seen with this identifier, unchanged. X-Matched-As and X-Matched-Value are present when it was found under another form of the identifier.

404.description: No aircraft with this identifier is in the air and seen by the network right now. The body says what was tried, a hint, `found_as` when the text is another identifier of an airborne aircraft, and `last_seen`, the last observed flight, when there is one.

get.summary: One aircraft by registration

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: Registration, e.g. MM62179; case, spaces, dashes and dots ignored (SP-GPM = SPGPM).

200.description: The aircraft currently seen with this identifier, unchanged. X-Matched-As and X-Matched-Value are present when it was found under another form of the identifier.

404.description: No aircraft with this identifier is in the air and seen by the network right now. The body says what was tried, a hint, `found_as` when the text is another identifier of an airborne aircraft, and `last_seen`, the last observed flight, when there is one.

get.summary: One aircraft by callsign, flight number, registration or ICAO address
get.description: For when you do not know which identifier you have: tries the text as a callsign (with the same forms as /v2/callsign), a registration (dashes ignored) and an ICAO address, and says how each airborne aircraft matched (at most one per kind, the same aircraft once). https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#callsign-and-flight-number

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: A callsign, flight number, registration or ICAO address.

404.description: No aircraft with this identifier is in the air and seen by the network right now. The body says what was tried, a hint, `found_as` when the text is another identifier of an airborne aircraft, and `last_seen`, the last observed flight, when there is one.

get.summary: All aircraft within a radius of a point
get.description: The radius is in kilometres (ADSBx v2 uses nautical miles). The maximum radius depends on the plan: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/#piani.

400.description: lat, lon or dist is not a number.

403.description: The radius is above the plan's maximum (the body carries max_radius_km and a link to the plans).

get.summary: Military aircraft
get.description: Aircraft whose dbFlags has the military bit (bit 0).

get.summary: PIA aircraft
get.description: Aircraft whose dbFlags has the PIA (Privacy ICAO Address) bit (bit 2).

get.summary: LADD aircraft
get.description: Aircraft whose dbFlags has the LADD bit (bit 3).

get.summary: Aircraft by squawk
get.description: Aircraft squawking this code, network-wide. Alias: /v2/squawk/{squawk}.

get.summary: Aircraft by squawk (alias of /v2/sqk)
Aircraft by ICAO type
get.description: Aircraft of this ICAO type designator, network-wide.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: ICAO type designator, 2-4 letters or digits, case-insensitive, e.g. A320.

get.summary: Dates with a recorded track for one aircraft
One aircraft's track for one day
get.description: readsb's trace_full file for that aircraft and day, passed through as written. From 2022-04-10 to 2023-10-04 the archive holds imported Virtual Radar Server data: only the first and last point of each flight ("version": "vrs-basestation-import"). The current day is built from readsb's live trace files (X-History-Source live), or from the overflights store once readsb no longer has the aircraft (store: position, altitude, flags, source and callsign only); it may answer 503 while a file is being written.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future.

X-History-Source.description: Where the day was read from: `local` (the server), `r2` (the archive), `live` (today, readsb's live trace) or `store` (today, the overflights store).

400.description: icao or date is malformed, or the date is in the future.

404.description: No trace for this aircraft on this date.

502.description: The archived trace could not be read.

503.description: The archive is briefly unavailable, or today's file is being written: retry shortly.

get.summary: Profile of one aircraft
get.description: Identity (registration, ICAO type, type description, year, decoded dbFlags), live status (position, callsign and position source when received now) and a history summary (first and last day with a track, days in the last 30 UTC days, total days; the same dates as /v2/history/{icao}), plus links to the public map and to a public photo page. One request. Never returns owner or operator names. No photo is embedded: Planespotters.net's API terms forbid re-serving their photos through another API, so `photos.page` is a link to their public page, and it is null (with `withheld`) for PIA and LADD aircraft.

404.description: Not received now and no recorded history for this aircraft.

503.description: Live data or the archive is briefly unavailable: retry shortly.

get.summary: Aircraft that flew over a place in a time window
get.description: Every aircraft whose recorded track passed within `dist` km of the point between `from` and `to`, one entry per aircraft, sorted by the time of its closest point. Tracks are interpolated between received positions (gaps over 5 minutes are not). Covers the days since 2026-08-17, the current day up to about 10 minutes ago, and the periods not searched are listed in `coverage.gaps`. One request per call. The maximum `dist` and window depend on the plan (Free 10 km / 6 h, Starter 25 km / 24 h, others 50 km / 24 h): https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/#piani. Aircraft data only: registration, type, description and dbFlags, never the owner or operator.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start: ISO 8601 (UTC when there is no offset) or Unix seconds.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End, after `from`: ISO 8601 or Unix seconds. A time in the future is cut to now.

parameters.name: max_alt_ft
parameters.description: Only the part of each track at or below this altitude (feet); positions without altitude are left out.

200.description: The overflights, with what was searched.

400.description: A parameter is missing or malformed, `to` is not after `from`, or the circle contains a pole.

403.description: `dist` or the window is above the plan's maximum (the body carries max_dist_km and max_window_hours).

503.description: Too many searches at once, or the index is briefly unavailable: retry shortly (Retry-After).

get.summary: A callsign's observed flights and usual routes
get.description: The flights of a callsign the network observed in the last days, newest first, and its usual routes (`usual`, with how many times each was flown). The callsign takes the same forms as /v2/callsign, so a flight number works too (matched_as/matched_value say which form matched). A callsign with no flights answers 200 with count 0. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#observed-flights

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days back, up to yesterday.

400.description: A parameter is malformed or out of range.

503.description: The flights index is briefly unavailable: retry shortly.

get.summary: One aircraft's observed flights (flight log)
get.description: One aircraft's observed flights between two UTC days (default the last 7 available days, at most 31 per request), newest first, with a summary (flights, minutes, airports) for flight hours. An aircraft with no flights in the period answers 200 with count 0. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#observed-flights

400.description: A parameter is malformed or out of range.

503.description: The flights index is briefly unavailable: retry shortly.

get.summary: One aircraft's observed flights, by registration
get.description: One aircraft's observed flights between two UTC days (default the last 7 available days, at most 31 per request), newest first, with a summary (flights, minutes, airports) for flight hours. An aircraft with no flights in the period answers 200 with count 0. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#observed-flights

parameters.name: reg
parameters.description: Registration; case, spaces and dashes ignored.

400.description: A parameter is malformed or out of range.

503.description: The flights index is briefly unavailable: retry shortly.

get.summary: Departures or arrivals observed at an airport on one day
get.description: The flights observed leaving (or reaching) an airport on one UTC day, sorted by time. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/endpoints/#observed-flights

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Airport ICAO (e.g. EGLL) or IATA (e.g. LHR) code.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; default the latest day available.

400.description: A parameter is malformed or out of range.

503.description: The flights index is briefly unavailable: retry shortly.

get.summary: The position saved on the key's account
get.description: For "aircraft near me": the position the user saved (My API, or the MCP tool set_my_location), rounded to about 1 km. Not counted as a request. `location` is null when none is saved.

post.summary: Save the position on the key's account
post.description: Replaces any saved position. Stored rounded to 2 decimals (about 1 km). At most 10 changes a minute per key.

400.description: lat or lon is missing or out of range.

post.summary: Delete the position saved on the key's account

get.summary: Notable traffic within a radius since a time
get.description: Events recorded by the network: emergencies (squawk 7500/7600/7700 or the ADS-B emergency status, not "lifeguard"), military aircraft and "interesting" aircraft (dbFlags bits 0 and 1). One event per aircraft, kind and ~0.5° grid cell it entered, so a long flight appears once per cell; a new event for the same cell only after 30 (emergency) or 60 minutes away. Newest first. Counted as one request; the plan's radius applies. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/alerts/

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 (no zone = UTC). Default 24 hours ago, at most 7 days ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Unix seconds or ISO 8601. Default now.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of emergency, military, interesting. Default all.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many events (1–500, default 100).

400.description: A parameter is missing or out of range (the error says which).

403.description: The radius is above the plan's maximum (the body carries max_radius_km and a link to the plans).

get.summary: The account's webhooks
get.description: Never includes the signing secret. Not counted as a request (at most 20 webhook calls a minute per key).

200.description: The webhooks, and the maximum per account.

post.description: Paid plans only, at most 5 per account. The URL must be https on port 443 or 8443 and resolve only to public addresses. The answer carries the signing secret, shown this once. dist is capped by the plan's radius.

400.description: Invalid JSON, url not allowed (code "url-not-allowed"), or an area or kind out of range.

409.description: The account already has the maximum number of webhooks (code "webhook-limit").

get.summary: A webhook's last 20 deliveries

404.description: No webhook with this id for this account.

post.description: Allowed on any plan. Pending deliveries are cancelled.

404.description: No webhook with this id for this account.

post.summary: Enable a webhook again after it was disabled
post.description: A webhook is disabled after 15 failed attempts in a row over at least an hour. This resets the count.

404.description: No webhook with this id for this account.

post.description: Queues one `webhook.test` delivery, signed like the others, attempted once. See its outcome in /deliveries.

404.description: No webhook with this id for this account.

409.description: The webhook is disabled (code "disabled"): enable it first.

post.summary: Request an API key by email
post.description: Sends a one-time link (valid 7 days) to the address; opening it shows the key once. The key is never in this response or in the email. Requesting again for the same address rotates the self-serve key when the new link is used; until then the old key keeps working. One free key per mailbox (+tag and Gmail-dot variants count as the same mailbox); temporary email domains are refused.

found_via.description: Required. How you found FlyItalyADSB. An agent signing up for its user sends the assistant it is (e.g. claude, chatgpt); the official Python client sends pypi.

400.description: Missing or invalid email, a temporary email domain (code "disposable-email"), a missing or unknown found_via (code "found-via-required", with the accepted codes in "allowed"), or invalid JSON.

429.description: A key was requested for this address a few minutes ago.

post.summary: A notable-traffic event, sent to your webhook URL
post.description: Signed with Standard Webhooks (https://www.standardwebhooks.com/): HMAC-SHA256 with the base64-decoded part of the secret after "whsec_", over "{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body}". Reject a timestamp more than 5 minutes away and dedupe on webhook-id, which is the same on every retry. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else (redirects included) is retried 6 times over about 5 hours. https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/docs/alerts/

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: msg_<delivery id>, the same on every retry.

X-FIA-Plan.description: The key's plan (free, feeder, starter, pro, business, enterprise).

X-FIA-Used-Month.description: Requests counted this month for the key.

X-Matched-As.description: Present when the aircraft was found under another form of the identifier: callsign, reg or icao.

X-Matched-Value.description: The form that matched, e.g. RYR5518 for FR5518, SP-GPM for SPGPM.

TooManyRequests.description: Per-minute limit (key or, on Free, IP) or the plan's monthly quota. Per-minute answers carry Retry-After.

tried.description: The forms tried: a list for /v2/callsign and /v2/reg; for /v2/find an object (callsign list, reg, icao).

hint.description: Why it may not be found, e.g. a flight number is not always the callsign.

found_as.description: The text is another identifier of an aircraft in the air: where to ask for it. Never another aircraft in place of the asked one.

last_seen.description: The last flight observed for it in the past 7 days, when there is one.

FlightEnd.description: One end of an observed flight; null when it was not identified.

airport.description: ICAO code (or the local code of a small airfield).

time.description: Unix seconds: when the network saw the aircraft at this end.

seen.description: How the airport was recognised: ground (on the ground within 6 km), low (at most 2,500 ft above it within 15 km), approach (at most 6,000 ft within 30 km, heading consistent). ground/low times are close to take-off or landing.

Flight.description: A flight observed by the network, not an airline schedule. Never the owner or operator.

duration_min.description: Observed minutes, first to last point.

day.description: UTC day the flight started; flights across midnight UTC are joined.

FlightsCoverage.description: The days searched; missing = days in the period that are not built (yet).

matched_as.description: Present when a translated form matched (e.g. a flight number).

help.description: On 401, 403 and 429: the FAQ answer for this error.

TrafficEvent.description: An event, plus the aircraft fields known at that moment with readsb's names (flight, r, t, desc, year, alt_baro, gs, track, squawk, emergency, category, dbFlags); `source` is readsb's position type. Never the owner or operator.

time.description: When the aircraft was seen entering the cell.

distance_km.description: From the query point (or the webhook centre).

map.description: The aircraft on the live map.

status.description: paused-plan: the account has no paid key now.

secret.description: whsec_…, shown only in this answer.

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt.

data.description: The event (TrafficEvent, with webhook_id and distance_km from the webhook centre), or {webhook_id, message} for a test.

Aircraft.description: A record from readsb's aircraft.json. Which fields are present depends on what was received; only common ones are listed.

hex.description: ICAO address; a leading ~ marks a non-ICAO (e.g. TIS-B) address.

type.description: Source of the current position, e.g. adsb_icao, mlat, tisb_icao.

total.description: Same as count, the field name of ADSBx v2.

archive_unavailable.description: Present when the archive could not be listed: only recent days are included.

year.description: Year of manufacture, when the aircraft database has it.

trace_day.description: The day whose track supplied type_description and year.

live.description: When seen_now is true, also: now, callsign, source (adsb_icao, mlat, tisb_icao…) and the aircraft.json fields lat, lon, alt_baro, alt_geom, gs, track, baro_rate, squawk, emergency, category, seen, seen_pos, mlat.

now.description: Time of the live data, Unix seconds.

days_last_30.description: Days with a track among today and the previous 29 (UTC).

archive_unavailable.description: Present when the archive could not be listed: recent days only.

map.description: The public map on this aircraft: live, or its last track the map can show.

page.description: Public photo page on Planespotters.net (no image in this API).

withheld.description: Why there is no photo link.

truncated.description: More passes exist than were returned.

complete_until.description: When truncated: every pass whose closest_time is before this is listed. Ask again from here.

gaps.description: Periods NOT searched (not indexed yet, not covered, or tracks that could not be read).

passes.description: Separate times it entered the circle.

positions.description: Received positions inside the circle; 0 = interpolated between positions outside it.

history.description: The /v2/history paths of the days read.

Trace.description: readsb trace_full JSON: icao, timestamp, and trace (array of points relative to timestamp), plus aircraft metadata.
